fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on Aadhaar. PMKSY aims to provide water to every field (Har Khet Ko Pani) and improve water use efficiency (More Crop Per Drop).
fields.instruction_hi: Aadhaar ke anusar poora naam likhein. PMKSY ka lakshya har khet ko paani dena (Har Khet Ko Pani) aur paani upyog dakshata sudharna (More Crop Per Drop) hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your total land holding in hectares. PMKSY provides subsidy on micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler). Small farmers get higher subsidy.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni kul bhumi dhaaraata hectare mein likhein. PMKSY micro-irrigation systems (drip aur sprinkler) par subsidy deti hai. Chhote kisaanon ko zyada subsidy milti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Select the irrigation system you want to install — Drip Irrigation or Sprinkler Irrigation. Drip is better for row crops, sprinkler for field crops.
fields.instruction_hi: Jo irrigation system lagana chahte hain woh chunein — Drip Irrigation ya Sprinkler Irrigation. Drip row fasalon ke liye behtar hai, sprinkler field fasalon ke liye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the Khasra/Survey number of the field where irrigation is to be installed. The subsidy is linked to specific land parcels.
fields.instruction_hi: Us khet ka Khasra/Survey number likhein jahan irrigation lagani hai. Subsidy specific bhoomi parcel se judi hoti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter bank account number for subsidy transfer. PMKSY subsidy is transferred directly to farmer's account after installation verification.
fields.instruction_hi: Subsidy transfer ke liye bank khata number likhein. PMKSY subsidy installation verification ke baad seedhe kisan ke khate mein transfer hoti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar for identity verification and subsidy disbursement.
fields.instruction_hi: Pahchaan verification aur subsidy vitaran ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein.
